title: L7 / C04: plain-English VSR draft for Rhys
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/handover/C04-VSR-DRAFT.md with exact version/scope/evidence fields, IQ/OQ/PQ planned and actual results, deviations/retests, all eight proposed limits and other risks, and blank Rhys/reviewer/John decisions/signatures. Actual results and approved counts remain human entries; refreshed reference counts do not silently discard older transfer scope.

Distinguishes validation, independent review and operational GO; missing/high-risk pre-use controls still block use. No test/log is promoted to human acceptance.

Checks: source sections/count distinctions, complete evidence/risk/deviation fields, no prefilled results/signatures, whitespace pass. Handover embedded. Documentation only; one independent draft, no main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
